name: memepump
description: MemePump is a read-only Solana token safety checker for AI assistants: it returns a token's risk score, honeypot signal, liquidity-lock status, mint and freeze authority, holder concentration and wallet clusters over MCP. It cannot trade or move funds and never asks for a wallet key. Output is informational, not financial advice.
suggestedPrompts: Is this Solana token a rug? Mint: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v
Who holds most of this token, and do any wallets look linked?
Explain what a freeze authority means in a token safety report
